title: Mark single links nofollow or sponsored
problem: Every link counted the same, so paid or customer links could not be marked.
now: Each link in the text can be nofollow, sponsored or user content, and open in a new tab.
steps: Open a blog post with a link.
In Links press Nofollow and New tab.
Update, then view the post: the link carries them.
notes: Where: Any editor › Search engine listing › Links

steps.eval: (async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { const b = document.querySelector('.mn-x'); if (!b) break; b.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); } })()
